# Savelle McThias

> Senior product designer and creative director with two decades of experience, specializing in enrollment and conversion UX for high-stakes user moments. Based in Scottsdale, AZ, available for remote roles.

Savelle McThias is a senior product designer and creative director based in Scottsdale, Arizona, with two decades of experience across direct sales, regulated industries, and enterprise e-commerce platforms, including PetSmart, Plexus Worldwide, and Green Compass. Currently available for remote senior or lead product design roles, or enrollment and conversion design work.

## Case Studies

- [Green Compass](https://savellem.com/case-studies/green-compass-digital-experience): From-scratch distributor enrollment flow for a CBD wellness company, built as Director of Digital Experience. 25% fewer customer service calls, 12% less cart abandonment, 15% more distributor enrollments, 90 days from design to launch.
- [Card Ritual](https://savellem.com/case-studies/card-ritual): Solo-founded, designed, and built a tarot journaling web app (React Native, Next.js, Astro) in 3 months from concept to live product. Live today with paying subscribers at $5/month.
- [Yoli](https://savellem.com/case-studies/yoli-patient-practitioner-dashboard): Patient and practitioner dashboard system for an at-home Omega-3 blood test, sole product designer on the system. Now used by roughly 30,000 patients and 5,000 medical professionals; enrollment up 12% since the new intake form launched.
- [iFoodDS](https://savellem.com/case-studies/ifoodds-compliance-app-rebuild): Tablet-first rebuild of a food-safety compliance app used across the agriculture supply chain, restructuring 3k+ forms into role-based navigation. Adoption up 70% from a 30% starting base; ~60% less time spent finding forms and documents.
- [PetSmart](https://savellem.com/case-studies/petsmart-navigation-redesign): Sitewide navigation and homepage redesign for petsmart.com's 1M+ page e-commerce catalog, reordering navigation around the pet instead of the product category. 10% increase in navigation usage, 20% increase in purchases of in-house brands.

## About

- [About](https://savellem.com/about): Two decades of product design experience spanning Savelle LLC (Founder & Principal Designer, 2021–present), Green Compass (Director of Digital Experience, 2024), iFoodDS, SyberSafe, Plexus Worldwide, and PetSmart. Skills include UX/UI design, design systems, front-end development (React, Angular), and data-driven design.
